definitions.explanation: A simple, abbreviated drawing that shows the essential features of something without fine detail. Used for maps, floor plans, explanatory diagrams, and similar illustrations.

examples.japanese: {略図|りゃくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧。
⟦{道順|みちじゅん}→道順：19280_michijun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{略図|りゃくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I drew a rough map of the directions on a note.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧{略図|りゃくず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{添付|てんぷ}→添付：07376_tenpu⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A simplified diagram showing the building layout was attached to the report.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{略|りゃく}→略：21443_ryaku⟧ (abbreviation, simplification) + ⟦{図|ず}→図：03368_zu⟧ (diagram, drawing). A {略図|りゃくず} shows only the essential elements and omits details, unlike a detailed blueprint or technical drawing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {略図|りゃくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧ — to draw a rough sketch
- {略図|りゃくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧ — to show a simplified diagram
- ⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧{略図|りゃくず} — simplified layout diagram
- ⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧{略図|りゃくず} — rough area map

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見取|みと}り{図|ず}→見取り図：14836_mitorizu⟧ — floor plan, sketch map; often specifically a plan view of a room or building
- {概略図|がいりゃくず} — schematic diagram; more technical term
- ⟦スケッチ→スケッチ：22554_sukecchi⟧ — sketch; loanword, can refer to artistic sketches as well
